content: Kahnẽn te yãy xaxok
Hãpxip kutõgnãg 'ĩhã tik xop nũn, nũy Yeyox yĩy 'ãpax, tu gohet pupi tikmũ'ũn yõg tayũmak pop, ha Yoneo yõg tikmũ'ũn te nõm tik xop putup nõg,
ha Paniye xop xix hãmyũmmũg xop te Yeyox 'ãktux kummuk, hu: Nũ tik te tik kummuk hã' xape, tu nõm mũtik xit. Yã kummuk Yeyox. Kaxĩy.
Ha Yeyox te hãmyũmmũgãhã', tu Topa yõg hãpxopmã'ax yũmmũgã', tu kahnẽn 'ãktux hã hãmyũmmũgãhã', nũy tu Topa te tikmũ'ũn kummuk xak 'ãktux, hu:
—Tikmũ'ũn yõg kahnẽn te 100, tu kahnẽn puxet xaxok, hu' mõg, tu' xip'ax kox, tu kahnẽn xop te 99 nĩm, nũy kahnẽn puxet xak, tu' xak, tu mõktu xipihi',
tu xipihi', tu ta' kuxa hittup xexkah, tu' nũn putpu', tu kahnẽn te' yĩpak hã' tat,
tu' nũn tu nũktu xupep yãy pet tu', tu' xape xop xãnãhã', xix hãm yĩmap ha' pip xop xãnãhã', tu: “'Ãkuxa hittup 'ũgmũtik! Yã 'ãte yãy yõg kahnẽn xipihi!” Kaxĩy. Ta tu' kux.
—Kaxĩy pexkox kopa' pip xop kuxa hittup xexkah, tik kummuk yãyhãhup ha' hittup xexkah, pa' kuxa hittup kutõgnãg 'ĩhã tik xop te yãy pe'paxex, hu: “'Ũgmax.” Kaxĩy.

Ha Yeyox te tayũmak hã hãmyũmmũgãhã', nũy Topa yõg hãpxopmã'ax yũmmũgã', nũy Topa te tikmũ'ũn kummuk xak 'ãktux, hu: —'Ũn puxet te tayũmak 'ãnuk te 10 pip, tup-xet xaxok, tu' xak, tu kuyãnãm hã' xak, tu' pet kunut xit max, tu' xak,
tu' xipihi', tu' paha', tu' kuxa hittup, tu' xape xop xãnãhã', xix hãmhũmnãg ha' pip xop, tu: 'Ãkuxa hittup 'ũgmũtik, 'ãxop. 'Ãte yãy yõg tayũmak 'ãnuk xipihi'!” Kaxĩy. Ta tu' kux.
—Kaxĩy pexkox yõg mõ'pok xop kuxa hittup, tik kummuk ta yãyhãhup ha' kuxa hittup. Kaxĩy.
Tik kutok xupaha'
Tu xe hãm'ãktux nũy hãmyũmmũgã', nũy Topa yõg hãpxopmã'ax yũmmũgã', nũy Topa te tikmũ'ũn kummuk putup 'ãktux, pu tu yãyhãhup, xix hãpkummuk mĩy kux. Tu hãm'ãktux, hu: —Tik tek-tok pit 2, yã' xip tap,

hak-tok te' nõy hã' kuhmõy te yãy tak pu hãm'ãktux, hu: “'Ãtak, 'ãxok, kopxix 'ãte 'õg hãpxop pop, 'ũyãg pop'ax, pa hõnhã 'ãte' yãg putup, yã tayũmak putup tek putex. 'Ãte' hip putup'ah, xa 'ãxok. 'Ã' hõm nõmhã, 'ũyĩy nõmenax, nũy tayũmak pop, nũyk mõg hãptox tu'.” Kaxĩy. —Ha' tak te hãpxop xohix koxip, tuk-tok te kuhmõy tu tu' yãg popmãhã'.
Hãpxip kutõgnãg 'ĩhãk-tok te 'ũyãg tayũmak pop, tu' mõg hãptox tu', tu mõktu hãpxexka puknõg tu' xupep, tu hãpkummuk mĩy pax, tu tayũmak xexka xaxogãnãg, ha' nõg.
—Ha' hok, 'ũyõg tayũmak hoknãg, ha hãmhõgnãg hãpxexka xohix tu', yĩy putup tep-tex, xix hãpxexka yõg tikmũ'ũn xohix kix,
ha hãpxop 'ũm xak, nũy mã', tu: 'Ũm hõm. 'Ũgmã', kaxĩy, ha' nõy te yãy yõg hãm tu mõ'kutnãhã', pu xapup pẽnã',
ha putup tep-tex, hu xapup xit'ax xak, pa' hõm 'ohnãg tik te',
yĩy yãy koxak, tu yãy mũtik hãm'ãktux, hu: “'Ãtak yõg kãmãnat xop xit punethok, tu tu' hix ka'ok, ha putup tek putex.
Put puk mõg 'ãtak hah, yãy 'Ãtak pet hak mõg'ax, tu hãm'ãktux'ax, hu: “'Ãtak, 'ãte hãpkummuk mĩy pax, tu yãyhãhup Topa tu', xix xa tu',
'Ãmax, hak mũn kummuk, tu xa' hupmãhã', puk mũn yã 'ãk-tok 'ãktux. 'Ũktux hok puk hãm 'õg kãmãnat xop mũtik.” Kaxĩy.

Tu putpu' mõg yãy tak pet hah. —Tu mõktu' pet tu' xupep, hak-tok te hãptox tu' xip, 'ĩhã' tak te' pẽnãhã', tuk-tok te' nõy hã kuhmõy kuxa ka', tu' mõg mõ'ka'ok, tuk-tok mũg yãy kep hah, nũy tu 'ãneo, ta tu' kuxa hittup tu 'ãneo,
hak-tok te: “'Ãtak, 'ãte hãpkummuk mĩy pax, tu Topa pu hãpkummugãhã', xix 'ãmũn pu', tu xa hupmãhã puk mũn yã 'ãk-tok 'ãktux.” Kaxĩy.
—Pãyã' tak te kãmãnat xat, tu: “Mõ'ka'ok, mõg, tu topixxax max popnũ', pu xõnnũ tat, ha hãpxop 'ũm yãnãm paxnũ pu xõnnũ tu yĩpkutok ha mõ'tat, ha pata xax max popnũ', pu' tat,
ha mũnũytut kutok tuktup max nũnnã', tup-tex. 'Ãpu yũmũ nõ 'ãmuk xexka mĩy 'ũghittup tu'.
Xõnnẽ nũn, ha yũmũg kuxa hittup. Hõmã' xok putuk, tu' hittup nõmhã, hõmã' xupaha, tu' putpu' nũn nõmhã.” Kaxĩy. —Tu 'ãmuk xexka mĩy!
—Hak-tok te mãxap xip, hãpxa xexka tu' xip, tu putpu' nũn yãy pet hah, tu kãyã 'ãpak, xix hãmyã 'ãpak,
yĩy: “Pute 'ũm nũhũ'? Tep tu tikmũ'ũn kãyãhã yĩy hãmyã'?” Kaxĩy.
—Ha: “'Ãtaknõy nũn, ha 'ãtak xat pu mũnũytut kutok putex, 'ũkuxa hittup tu', 'ũk-tok putpu' nũn ha' kuxa hittup.” Kaxĩy.
—Pak-tok te mãxap gãy, tu' mõ'nãp-tup'ah mĩptut hã', ha' tak nũn, tu ta tu' xapit, pu mõnãy,
pak-tok te: “Hãmyãxatamuk xohix hã xatek-xat, hak yĩpkox xip, tu' mĩy, pãyã xate hãpxop 'ũm 'a' hõm'ah, xate mot kutok kutõgnãg 'a' hõm 'ohnãg, puk xape xop mũtik 'ãmuk xexka mĩy,
pa 'ãk-tok nõy nũn, tu' xotit xop punethok pẽnãhã', tu 'õg tayũmak hã' pagok, ha tayũmak nõg, ha 'ãha' nũn putpu', ha xate 'ãmuk xexka mĩy!” Kaxĩy.
Ha' tak te: “Xõnnũ'! Hãmyãxatamuk xohix hã 'ũgmũtik 'ãxip, ha 'ãte yãy yõg hãpxop xohix popmãp-tup xa'.

Yã' max yũmũg kuxa hittup, nũy 'ãmuk xexka mĩy, 'ãtaknõy put pu' nũn, ha yũmũg kuxa hittup. Yã' xok putuk, pãyã' hi', tu' xupaha', pãyã' putpu' nũn.” Kaxĩy. Tu ta tu' kux. Kaxĩy Yeyox te tikmũ'ũn yũmmũgãhã', tu Topa te tikmũ'ũn kummuk xak 'ãktux, puyĩy yãyhãhup, xix hãpkummuk mĩy kux, nũy tu kuxa hittup.
